item.title: Sculptural Success Starts The New Year For A&O
item.description: ATLANTA — Ahlers & Ogletree’s New Year’s Signature Estates Auction was conducted January 14-15, presenting nearly 650 lots of fine art, decorative arts and English, French and Italian antiques from select private collections. Jamia Berry, the firm’s marketing and advertising coordinator, reported a sell-through rate of 97 percent, realizing $1,053,025 in total.
